title: The Broken Homecoming
author: Hazel Joubert
blurb: Oscar Okafor, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
